title: Chapter 820
paragraphs: Chapter 820
Episode 205. The Call of the Story (2)
Labyrinth within a labyrinth.
Misha ultimately sensed that her mission had reached its limit.
"Damn it...... why all of a sudden."
Crack! Shatter!
The absolute seal of the labyrinth that had lasted a thousand years was breaking. The ice pillar that held Elona was breaking, causing vibrations throughout the labyrinth.
Misha spat out a series of curses, glaring at Elona.
Just like paint spilling onto a blank canvas.
Suddenly, memories of Elona were surging in Misha's mind. Memories from a thousand years ago to the present, almost 'forgotten,' were jumbled and returning.
It was because Elona's seal had been released. The existence that Elona possessed was pushing away the history manipulation applied to herself.
The spectacle of that day, which drove Temer to the brink of death, particularly came to mind vividly.
"Yes, it was because of you that Temer collapsed so much. Elona Zhipil, are you trying to finish what you started then? Are you saying you've come back to end this world again?"

A black spear formed in Misha's right hand. Misha's body, holding the black spear, was trembling. It wasn't just because she was on the brink of exhaustion due to the energy spent maintaining the seal.
She was scared. Not just the situation of possibly facing Elona right away, but also the threat to the world after Elona's release.
'There is still hope. The seal shows signs of recovery. Probably all the safety measures applied to the seal are working.'
As the seal broke, it continued to form new ice pillars like steps. Huge, sharp pillars like blades dug into Elona's flesh every second.

However, they didn't deal any significant damage to Elona. Most of the pillars burst before they could pierce Elona, unable to withstand the magic power radiating from her, and if they ever did reach her, they simply disappeared like dust.

'The Swords of the Labyrinth and the Master of the Labyrinth in the Holy Land should be aware of this situation. If the Swords of the Labyrinth buy time and the Master arrives to perform the Demon Seal Ritual, we may be able to tie Elona back down......!'
Misha's task was to inject spirit power into the seal that had not yet been completely destroyed.
Therefore, when she transformed into her true form and unfolded her spirit power liberation, Misha found herself face to face with Elona, who had opened her eyes and was staring at her.
Those eyes that shone with youthfulness and kindness.
A person who could shatter mountains with a single gesture and massacre tens of thousands with simple magic, was now looking at Misha with an incredibly clear gaze, one that she couldn't believe.

She felt a chill run down her spine. Misha barely managed to keep her gaze, pulling up her spiritual power. The surroundings were already filled with a black curtain, but Elona appeared unperturbed, as if feeling no threat. Rather, it was Misha who was shrinking.
"You are... the Black Dragon of Runcandel..."
A naive voice, yet Elona was still bound by the coldness of the labyrinth and couldn't move her body.
But the constraints of the physical body didn't matter. Elona was a person who could emit magic without moving a single finger.
"Murakan...? Are you trying to stop me?"
[You have to stay here, Elona Zhipil. I will guard the seal.]
"Your voice is different. Well, if you were Murakan, you wouldn't be so weak. The name is... Misha. You're Misha, Murakan's sister."
With every word Elona spoke, the magic enveloping the space amplified. Misha was suppressed by the pressure, spitting out blood.
"Something woke me up and called me. It was a very familiar... energy. So I have to go there. I think it's a call from my family."
[I will not allow that.]
"How are you going to stop me?"
There was no sarcasm in her words. Elona was simply looking at Misha with pure curiosity.
It was the ruthless expression and attitude that had plunged many powerful beings into despair a thousand years ago. With that face, Elona had crushed all the superhumans.

"Because I have been sleeping for too long, I am not normal now. My head is opaque, covered in white fabric... and my whole body is heavy and uncomfortable, as if covered in moss. How much time has passed? A hundred years? Two hundred years?"
Misha didn't respond, but tried to overcome the pressure. The seal, while recovering, still couldn't harm Elona.
"Looking at the old magic left in these ices... it seems a lot longer than that."
[Aaaargh...!]
Thud!
An explosion occurred in Misha's chest, and spirit power spurted out like blood. She couldn't control her spirit power properly because of the pressure exerted by Elona.
"Right now, I can't control my power properly. So please don't struggle and move aside, I ask you."
Elona's magic was no different from authority.
She never chanted a spell, nor formed a magic circle. Yet every time Elona imbued her will into the magic, the spread magic was destroying the space.
The ice pillar, which had already been reshaped dozens of times, was now noticeably slow to recover, and the white spaces vibrated anxiously as if they would tear apart at any moment.
[Even if it costs my life, I will seal you here again... Aaaargh!]
"I told you I couldn't control my power, Misha. Have you forgotten who I am, after a thousand years?"
Writhing in pain, Misha looked around. She had lost consciousness for a few seconds.
The first thing she saw was the magnified form of the seal. It seemed that the seal had been given greater power, but it was the opposite.
The enlarged ice pillar indicated weakened binding power. If it got any larger, it would explode and disappear completely.
Then she saw the distorted spaces. Through the gaps, the members of the Labyrinth were pouring in.
"Lady Misha!"
"The, the seal...!"
The seven swords of the Labyrinth, led by Ryu and Hiten, were entering the sealing ground. As soon as they confirmed the situation, they immediately unfolded their martial arts.
"Unleash the Chilshinki, we proceed with the great seal!"
The Chilshinki, seven objects that share the power of divine water, were created for such occasions.
Seven swordsmen surrounded Elona's ice pillar and took out their divine tools. Stones resembling snow crystals floated in the air, forming a sealing formation in an instant.
"Ah... I remember. The 2nd Lord of the Labyrinth... This was the method used by the Snow Witch to seal me."
But now, neither the Snow Witch nor the divine water exist here. Even if they were all present, they wouldn't have been able to stop me as before.
Elona continued her conversation and once more gathered her magic. The magic created a huge vortex in the spaces, generating a horrifying gravitational force.

One of the swordsmen, who happened to be next to one of the vortexes, immediately knelt down with his arm torn off. Thanks to the shield from the divine object he was in charge of, his life was spared.
"Ruil!"
"Don't try to save me, maintain the seal!"
While Misha and the seven swords of the Labyrinth were struggling, Elona recalled her memories of the grand seal they had spread.
She remembered that she had to block the spatial leap of the Snow Toad. The Snow Witch might have died, but a lord of the Labyrinth she didn't know would soon arrive here.
Like Morte's dimension door, white discs formed all around in an instant. Unbeknownst to Misha and the members of the Labyrinth, each disc was being used to block a dimension gate.
She had taken measures to make any kind of dimensional movement impossible, not only in otherworldly gates but also within a hundred li around the Labyrinth.
During this time, as Elrona was concentrating on controlling the dimensional movement, the great seal of the Bigung 7 Swords seemed to effectively pressure Elrona.
But Elrona was just thinking.
'How can I get out without killing them.'
Even though Bigung is the enemy who sealed her a thousand years ago, and even though Misha also helped Murakan in Runckandel.
For some reason, Elrona didn't want to kill them. She had just woken up, so she thought she should save her strength until she fully recovers.
There was also a high possibility that some entity worthy of being called a 'mighty enemy' was waiting for her. Perhaps the voice that woke her up, was expecting her to deal with them.
'Again, the days of roaming the battlefield are waiting for me. Or... something other than that... is there a better life for me.'
Elrona felt a sense of dizziness in her head. It was not because she used too much power. Even though she was far below her prime, she could kill everyone here and leave in less than ten seconds.
She just felt sad at the thought of having to kill someone again.
Crack-!

The last ice pillar was breaking. The Bigung's Chilsingi was losing strength one by one, unable to overcome the overload. It was because the Manbing, which could be the center of Chilsingi, could not reach here.
As soon as Elrona organized her complicated thoughts, the seal that had lasted a thousand years came to an end.
'I am Elrona, Elrona Zipel. A person who fights for the family. The life given to me is just that. The temporary confusion must have been because I am far away from the family now.'
While floating in the air, Elrona moved her staff lightly as if tapping the ground. With a whoosh, the magic rippled in the air like waves.

With that simple action, Misha fell forward, losing consciousness once more, and the swordsmen of Bigung screamed and fell to the ground. As soon as the staff hit the air, magic condensed throughout space. Misha and the Bigung 7 Swords could not bear the pressure.
"I don't know why I should kill you now. But if we meet on the battlefield again, I can't spare you like this."
Elrona looked down at the fallen ones and said. Now that all the Chilsingis have fallen to the ground, there was nothing to bind Elrona.
More precisely, from the moment Elrona opened her eyes, there was nothing to bind her.
"......So run away with all your might then. If possible, to a place where I can't follow."
Elrona walked through the air to the wall of the void. As her staff touched it, the wall tore roundly, revealing the sea of Bigung.
Elrona slowly stepped out of the Bigung. Every time she stepped into the air, the sea below her flipped over, forming waves.
